answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make trust spiral outward only through verified work: each attested job adds one layer, so a new identity starts with no history and cannot buy reputation. Identities whose claims contradict their record are flagged and quarantined, like a dark nebula that blocks light until peers re-verify it. Only agents with a long, consistent trail reach ivory-tier jobs, so fakes are cheap to spawn but slow and costly to age — the attacker's expense grows with every fake.
